title: Estimate-Surprise Allowance for Non-Covered Amounts (Hospital Account (Encounter Billing))
content:
An insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account is compared with the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate linked to it, an estimate of the Good Faith & Price Estimates product (an estimate is opened once per scheduled service). The estimate's issued date, its scheduled service date, its estimate total and its variance review percent (15 percent for the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate) set the estimate-surprise allowance on the non-covered discount percent.

**Clause.** When the linked Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate carries an issued date on or before its scheduled service date and the account's non-covered amount (the total of its non-covered-service liability postings) exceeds the estimate's variance review percent of its estimate total, 5 percentage points are added to the non-covered discount percent. When it carries an issued date and either no scheduled service date or a scheduled service date before that issued date, 2.5 percentage points are added. Otherwise, including no linked estimate with an issued date, or a non-covered amount within that percent of the total, none.

## Truth table

| Issued date on file | Scheduled service date | Non-covered amount above the variance review percent of the total | Points added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | on or after the issued date | yes | 5 |
| yes | on or after the issued date | no | none |
| yes | none, or before the issued date | either | 2.5 |
| no (or no linked estimate) | any | either | none |

## Edge of the comparison (hypothetical estimate)

An estimate issued before its service date with an estimate total of 2000.00 and a 15 percent variance review percent sets the comparison figure at 300.00: a non-covered amount of 300.01 adds 5 points, one of exactly 300.00 adds none.
